title: ocotea estrellensis
intro: Ocotea estrellensis, commonly known as Estrella or Star Aniseed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea estrellensis include relaxing and calming effects, which may help alleviate stress and anxiety, as well as providing pain relief and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Ocotea estrellensis include volatile oils, such as eugenol and linalool, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
